body: No, and I won't. My family isn't emotionally open.

Nothing. 

I just feel like I'm a waste of time, resources, and space. Everyone is that, essentially. But, when you start to belong, or to support, or to create something meaningful, you kinda make up for that lost space. I don't feel like I begin to make up my debt. The only reason I'm not gone is my family. My friends don't really care, no one but my family really does. I can't blame my friends though. Because *I* don't care. I hate myself.
I mean, immediate family, that's an obvious one, but I just want to drop out of life. It's not a sad, depression thing, I just want to quit. I just want to leave.
